name: Urapra Glycolic Acid 7% Toner 100ml | Exfoliating Face Solution for Clear & Radiant Skin
description:
Urapra Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution is a lightweight exfoliating toner that gently removes dead skin cells and unclogs pores for smoother, clearer skin. Infused with 7% glycolic acid, it promotes cell renewal, reduces dullness, fades dark spots, and minimizes fine lines. Suitable for all skin types, it enhances overall skin texture and radiance while prepping the skin for better absorption of serums and moisturizers.
Key Features
 Contains 7% glycolic acid for gentle exfoliation
 Brightens complexion and revives dull skin
 Fades pigmentation and evens skin tone
 Minimizes pores and smooths skin texture
 Prepares skin for better absorption of skincare products
 100ml bottle, ideal for daily use
How to Use
 Apply a small amount to a cotton pad
 Gently swipe over cleansed face and neck
 Use daily, preferably at night
 Follow with serum and moisturizer
Material
Glycolic acid, natural extracts, and hydrating agents
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Use sunscreen during the day
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × 100ml Urapra Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution
